title: Narrow gap in a wall line
description: Two Walls leave a 0.1-inch slit; the target stands in line with it.
basis: p. 30 partial line of sight (confirmed); U77
ruling: The middle column of points passes through the slit and the side columns hit the walls: Partial. Neither wall touches the target, so there is no cover. Limitation: a sliver of the target could be visible through a gap the fixed points miss. (Before L2: Partial 2/4.)
